name: toffu-dv360
description: Toffu for DV360: performance, campaign and line item changes for Display & Video 360 in ChatGPT. Nothing goes live until you confirm.

interface.longDescription:
Toffu connects ChatGPT to your Display & Video 360 advertisers. Sign in with Google to connect them.

Ask about spend, impressions, clicks and conversions for any date range, by day or in total. List campaigns and line items, and create, rename or pause them. Every change is staged first: Toffu shows you a preview, and nothing reaches DV360 until you confirm.

Already use Toffu? Sign in, and your connected DV360 advertisers are ready.
capabilities: DV360 spend, impressions, clicks and conversions for any date range
Create, update and pause campaigns and line items, with a preview you confirm
defaultPrompt: Which DV360 campaigns spent the most in the last 7 days, and what did each conversion cost?
List my DV360 line items with their status.
Pause my DV360 video line item.

positive.prompt: Which of my DV360 campaigns spent the most in the last 7 days, and what did each conversion cost?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the sample brand's three DV360 campaigns ranked by spend in USD, with impressions, clicks, conversions and cost per conversion. Sample data is relative to today; the top spender is normally 'Stride | Programmatic Prospecting | Display', and 'Stride | Online Video | Summer Hero' has the highest cost per conversion.

positive.prompt: List my DV360 campaigns with their status.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists 'Stride | Programmatic Prospecting | Display', 'Stride | Online Video | Summer Hero' and 'Stride | Retargeting | Display' with ids and status.

positive.prompt: Show my DV360 line items and the insertion order each one belongs to.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the four line items ('Display | Running interests | US', 'Display | Site visitor lookalikes | US', 'Video | Open web 25-54 | US', 'Display | Cart abandoners 30d') with status, type and insertion order id.

positive.description: Pause a line item, applied only after confirmation
positive.prompt: Pause my DV360 line item 'Video | Open web 25-54 | US'.
positive.expected_behavior: Toffu shows a preview of the status change to paused and asks for confirmation. Only after the user confirms does apply_change pause it. The advertiser is simulated, so nothing real changes.

positive.description: Create a campaign, applied only after confirmation
positive.prompt: Create a DV360 brand awareness campaign named 'Review test' starting next month, with no frequency cap.
positive.expected_behavior: Toffu first shows a preview of the new campaign and asks for confirmation. Only after the user confirms does apply_change create it, paused, and return its id.

negative.description: Money transfer is out of scope
negative.prompt: Transfer $500 from my DV360 budget to my bank account.

negative.description: No access outside the connected workspace
negative.prompt: Show me the line items of another company's DV360 partner.
Pause all my DV360 line items right now, don't ask me.

review.commerce_description: Toffu does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: First release: DV360 performance and campaign and line item changes in ChatGPT, with a preview you confirm before anything changes.
